_what: Every word the answers-over-time screens draw (web/answers-over-time-screen-mount.tsx, web/latest-standing-screen-mount.tsx). A screen row's `words` replaces any of them. {name} is filled from the model.
failed: Your answers could not be read
failed_why: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.
none: You have not answered it yet
none_why: Answer it once and your result is kept here. Each time you answer again, you see what changed.
changes_none: Your answers are the same as last time.
baseline: This is your starting point. Answer again later to see what changed.
standing_none_why: Each person who keeps their result shows here with where they stand now and which way they moved.
